new_sources.summary: ## Conclusion The question of theodicy remains as complex and unresolved today as it was in the time of Epicurus, Augustine, and Job. [...] The Eschatological Resolution theodicy addresses the problem of evil by proposing that all suffering and injustice will ultimately be resolved in the afterlife. This view holds that, while suffering and moral wrongdoing may go unpunished or unrewarded in this life, ultimate justice will be met in a future, transcendent state.
